metadata.title: Unit Placement Schema and Data Model
metadata.purpose: Defines the exact data structure for all 430,000+ unit placement records. Every placement record in placements_day1, placements_day2, placements_day3 must conform to this schema.

unit_id.description: Unique unit identifier matching OOB records. Format: U-[designation] for Union, C-[designation] for Confederate.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude of unit center point.

lng.description: WGS84 longitude of unit center point.

bearing.description: Direction the unit faces in degrees clockwise from north. 0=north, 90=east, 180=south, 270=west. Line of Battle extends perpendicular to bearing.

disposition.description: Current tactical formation of the unit. Controls rendering style.

strength.description: Current effective strength at this tick after cumulative casualties. Used to compute visual line length.

notes.description: Narrative note for this placement -- displayed in unit info panel at this tick.
examples: Armistead leads men over the wall

vignette_trigger.description: Vignette ID to trigger at this tick for this unit.

Charging Line.render: solid line with forward direction nub
Charging Line.note: Forward nub indicates direction of charge (perpendicular to line)

Skirmish Line.render: dotted line of individual soldier dots

Chaotic Retreat.render: scattered dots in roughly oval pattern
Chaotic Retreat.note: Same color for both sides -- chaos has no side

Deployed Artillery.render: short line with wheel circles at ends

coordinate_accuracy.standard_units: GPS accuracy to nearest 10-15 meters. Regiments placed at approximate regimental center.
coordinate_accuracy.critical_placements: GPS accuracy to nearest 5-10 meters for units with flag_notes. Cross-referenced against Gottfried maps and terrain data.
coordinate_accuracy.artillery: GPS accuracy to nearest 5 meters where possible. Gun positions are fixed points documented in sources.

bearing_conventions.line_of_battle: Unit faces direction of primary threat or advance. Perpendicular to enemy.
bearing_conventions.line_of_march: Bearing follows road or axis of movement.
bearing_conventions.cavalry: Bearing follows axis of movement or patrol line.

strength_progression.during_engagement: initial_strength minus casualties assigned per tick per casualty_apportionment.json
strength_progression.after_engagement: final post-battle strength maintained through remaining ticks of the battle
strength_progression.minimum: 10 men minimum for unit to render as line. Below 10 renders as single dot.

sequence.notes: Multiple assaults on Little Round Top
Armistead crosses the wall -- High Water Mark
Repulsed -- streaming back to Seminary Ridge

coverage_gaps.before_engagement: Units not yet on the battlefield appear in Bivouac at their off-map staging areas or are simply absent.
coverage_gaps.night_ticks: Both armies in Bivouac during nighttime ticks. Minimal movement shown.
coverage_gaps.retreating_units: Units that left the battlefield (e.g. broken Union regiments retreating through Gettysburg July 1) are shown in Chaotic Retreat for several ticks then disappear when they rally off-map.

record_format.placements_array: array of placement records conforming to placement_record_schema above
